strategy.user_problem: The existing Gate-connected Odoo addon returns EIE contact suggestions but its Inject action bulk-applies fields, security grants ordinary internal users full CRUD, ADR-012 has obsolete auto-writeback default language, and retired cron privileges/local injection remain.
strategy.outcome: Complete one source-owned Odoo addon: safe Gate-only, review-only by default, native per-field approve/reject, secure and idempotent writeback with truthful evidence and fully preserved historical run/provenance. Keep cron/auto-writeback disabled.
strategy.first_proof: At pinned Odoo 19 Enterprise, signed recorded-shape Gate converge for an existing company returns 3 eligible fields, one operator approves 2, rejects 1, and only 2 missing allowlisted fields are written exactly once with provenance, while base.user RPC, stale values, company mismatches and auto-writeback config all fail.
strategy.best_alternative: Continue to use existing JSON gate_proposal and one-click Inject with current broad ACLs; do not add proposal lines.
strategy.reason_selected: Bulk approval cannot produce individual, evidence-bound authorization or stable per-field conflict/receipt semantics; provenance already means committed writes and cannot safely double as pending proposals. One narrow proposal-line model in existing addon is justified; no new addon.
strategy.reversibility: Unchanged original kernel and source evidence; additive proposal table with migration after installed version census; old run/provenance protected; auto-writeback off; source DB/filestore restore; no cron resurrection.
strategy.future_seam: A future separately authorized Odoo consumer could handle source-owned CEG-ranked work without modifying EIE/CEG/Gate; this pack does not add the queue, scheduler or partnerless commercial creation.
